title: Virtual duality and non-simple-disc dualizing modules for unmarked handlebody groups of genus at least two
author: Dan Petersen; Richard D. Wade
work: The handlebody group is a virtual duality group
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 13 (2026), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.341
difficulty_reason: The prior duality criterion and contractible handlebody Teichmuller space leave the topology and integral freeness of its new boundary unresolved. The authors construct the RGB stratification and explicit colour retractions to identify that boundary with the suspension of the non-simple disc complex, then prove the required upper homological dimension by an exact cut-handlebody join calculation and genus induction. The split-injection colimit argument supplies free top homology, while the marked lower-genus cases are handled separately through the authored Birman extensions; these are the nonroutine remaining structural obligations.
